questions.question: At stage done, what should still refuse? Today write scope, review budget, test naming and verification all refuse the seal.
Is 'only Codex writes product code' a principle or a habit? T5a needed eleven degraded windows because the writer could not act after stage done or without network.
Is the plan review a gate or a review? A gate binds to bytes and refuses on drift; a review records findings against a version and lets you decide.
options: Review that records, not a gate (Recommended)
questions.chosen: Review that records, not a gate (Recommended)

questions.question: Per-task PRs or story PRs? Per-task drives the marker, frontier, reconcile and PR-contract machinery; story PRs remove it but batch the review.
